new_commodity_proposals.evidence: The pre-resolve board sweep returned 'no commodity and no capture match' for this term across the commodity namespaces and the capture feed, and no beef-roast id surfaced anywhere in this batch's tables. Eye of round is a distinct whole-muscle round roast, typically the cheapest oven roast on the beef case and priced per lb well under chuck roast or any steak cut, so it cannot be folded onto ground-beef-8020 or any stew-meat/chuck id without publishing a wrong price. I am forbidden from reading the namespace files directly, so this rests on the orchestrator's own sweep rather than a hand sweep - if a chuck-roast or beef-roast id already exists, it is a DIFFERENT cut and a different price, not an alias.

registrar_rulings.reason: No round-primal beef id exists in any namespace: swept commodities.json, recipe-commodities.json and recipe-board-everyday.json for round/rump/eye/sirloin/brisket and every hit resolved to unrelated rows (black-eyed in pea excludes, sirloin-steak's own include, sirloin/ribeye inside shaved-beef-steak's exclude list); smp-feed.json has no price cell for any eye-of-round/round-roast/rump string, so the food is neither present nor priced. chuck-roast ($6.64/lb, includes scoped to 'chuck\s+roast') is a different cut from a different primal and would publish a wrong price for this cheaper whole-muscle roast, so reuse is ruled out. Mint eye-of-round-roast as recipe-only (recipe-board-everyday baseline + recipe-commodities.json for sale overlay), unit lb, include patterns 'eye\s+of\s+round' and 'eye\s+round\s+roast' with the full ~150-pattern beef exclude block copied from sirloin-steak plus 'ground', 'steak', 'chuck', 'jerky', 'deli', 'lunch\s*meat', 'roast\s+beef\s+slice'; add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs (eye-of-round-roast, chuck-roast) and (eye-of-round-roast, beef-chuck-roast) reason 'different beef cuts: round primal vs chuck primal' so the daily audit's shared-token 'roast' rule never re-flags them. Caller edits via add-commodity-rule.ps1; note this ruling mints the ID only - the ingredient-name row for 'Boneless Eye of Round Roast' in meal-prep\db\ingredients.json is a separate vocabulary act the mapper's pre-resolve already shows is missing.

macro_cross_check.note: Recipe totals 4076 cal / 338.6 g protein at source scale. Protein is inside 6%, which is the sharp instrument, so the 3 1/4 lb beef weight is right.
